argument_markdown:
## Source-backed inputs

ATT-0065, dual-confirmed by REV-0108 and REV-0109, supplies the canonical balanced filtration, degrees 20 and 16, locally free ranks and base change, the filtered isomorphism coker(φ)≅coker(φ_5), the scheme-theoretic identity Fit_0(coker φ)=a_N^*I_e, and the conditional ambient comparison. Specifically, these are CLM-0065-1 through CLM-0065-5 and CLM-0065-7 through CLM-0065-9. The packet facts FND-0064, FND-0083, FND-0103, and FND-0107 supply the ordered/reduced-support boundary, its possible emptiness, the sharp Clifford range, and the Abel–Jacobi fibre model.

## Proved steps

By ATT-0065 (REV-0108; REV-0109), π_*W_4 and π_*W_5 have ranks 15 and 11, their evaluation targets have rank 6, and π_*W and its target have ranks 26 and 12. The filtered snake lemma gives coker(φ)≅coker(φ_5), so equality of zeroth Fitting ideals gives I_12(φ)=I_6(φ_5)=a_N^*I_e without splitting W.

At a geometric point b, the same exact sequence gives coker(φ_b)≅H^1(C_b,W_{5,b}(-Γ_b)). Serre duality identifies its dual with H^0(C_b,N_b), where N_b has degree zero. A degree-zero line bundle on a smooth connected projective curve has zero sections unless it is trivial, and has a one-dimensional section space when trivial. Thus dim coker(φ_b)≤1. Consequently rank(φ_b)∈{11,12} and rank((φ_5)_b)∈{5,6}. Hence the vanishing loci of I_11(φ) and I_5(φ_5) have no geometric points; Nakayama gives I_11(φ)=I_5(φ_5)=O_B.

Now fix a geometric balanced fibre C_b and let D be any effective divisor of degree six. Since H^1(W_{5,b})=0, the evaluation sequence shows that its cokernel is H^1(W_{5,b}(-D)). Its Serre dual is H^0(ω_{C_b}⊗W_{5,b}^∨(D)), a degree-zero line bundle. The cokernel is therefore nonzero exactly when O(D)≅W_{5,b}⊗ω_{C_b}^{-1}=L_b. By the Abel–Jacobi fibre description in FND-0107, these divisors form |L_b|=P(H^0(L_b)); thus its dimension is h^0(L_b)−1.

The degree formula gives deg L_b=6 and deg M_b=4. Riemann–Roch and Serre duality give h^0(L_b)−h^0(M_b)=χ(L_b)=1. Hence h^0(L_b)≥1. If h^0(M_b)>0, then M_b is special because h^1(M_b)=h^0(L_b)>0, and Clifford gives h^0(M_b)≤3. Thus h^0(L_b)∈{1,2,3,4}. If h^0(M_b)=3, the resulting g^2_4 is base-point-free: otherwise a degree-three line bundle would have three sections, contradicting Clifford. Its morphism to P^2 cannot be birational onto a plane quartic because such a curve has arithmetic genus three, so it is a double cover of a conic. Therefore C_b is hyperelliptic and M_b is twice the hyperelliptic pencil. Conversely that square has three sections, proving the stated equivalence. Since dim Sym^6(C_b)=6, the fibre codimension is 6−(h^0(L_b)−1)=7−h^0(L_b).

Finally, FND-0064 identifies ordered pairwise-distinct divisors with a finite étale S_6-cover of the reduced-support open. A nonempty open in |L_b| has the same dimension, but FND-0083 shows that χ(L_b)=1 does not prove this open is nonempty.

## Computational hypotheses

None. The declared EXP-C66-RANK has no result JSON, script SHA-256, or stdout SHA-256 artifact. No finite computation supports or closes any claim. The generic expected codimension of the effective 11→6 maximal-minor locus is formally 6, but this is only determinantal bookkeeping and is not asserted to equal any global codimension in M_{6,6}.

## Gaps

The theorem does not determine which h^0 value occurs on each balanced stratum, prove distinct-support nonemptiness, discharge the ambient equation-bundle hypothesis, or establish any image, component, stabilizer, closure, lci/Gysin, Hodge, purity, Tate, or RED-0001 conclusion.

summary: The dual-confirmed GEO-Z dependency determines the maximal-minor ideal and its Abel–Jacobi scheme structure. A degree-zero Serre-duality calculation rules out every deeper degeneracy locus. Fibrewise, the full effective-divisor rank-drop set is |W_5⊗ω^{-1}|, whose dimension is exactly h^0(L)−1 and can only be 0, 1, 2, or 3. theorem_scope.ambient_hypothesis: Ambient agreement retains the standard CE resolution and the separate hypothesis that q_*script-W is finite locally free and commutes with arbitrary base change, exactly as in ATT-0065.
theorem_scope.base: Locally Noetherian over a characteristic-zero field, with arbitrary locally Noetherian base change.
theorem_scope.divisor_hypothesis: The relative scheme-theoretic Fitting identity is asserted for the union of six pairwise-disjoint sections. The statement over all of Sym^6(C_b) is a geometric-fibre rank-set and dimension statement.
theorem_scope.not_covered: Global splitting W≅W_4⊕W_5; W_5≅ω^2(-D); nonemptiness of the distinct-support open; constancy of h^0(L); balanced Hurwitz-base dimension; image dimension or codimension in M_{6,6}; components, stabilizers, closure, lci/Gysin, purity, Tate type, or RED-0001.

theorem_statement: Theorem (filtered balanced CE rank ideals and fibre dimensions at (g,n)=(6,6)). Let k be a characteristic-zero field, B a locally Noetherian k-scheme, π:C→B a smooth proper family with geometrically connected genus-six fibres, and Γ the union of six pairwise-disjoint sections. Assume the balanced tetragonal Casnati–Ekedahl data induce the canonical filtration 0→W_4→W→W_5→0, where W_4 and W_5 are invertible of fibre degrees 20 and 16. Let φ:π_*W→π_*(W|_Γ) and φ_5:π_*W_5→π_*(W_5|_Γ), put N=ω_{C/B}⊗W_5^∨(Γ), and let a_N:B→Pic^0_{C/B} classify N with e the identity section. Then the graded evaluation maps have ranks 15→6 and 11→6, φ has ranks 26→12, and, without any global splitting of W, Fit_0(coker φ)=I_12(φ)=I_6(φ_5)=a_N^*I_e scheme-theoretically and compatibly with arbitrary locally Noetherian base change. Moreover I_11(φ)=O_B and I_5(φ_5)=O_B, so every geometric fibre has rank 12 or 11 for φ and rank 6 or 5 for φ_5, with no deeper rank drop. Under the additional standard CE-resolution and equation-bundle finite-local-freeness/base-change hypotheses of ATT-0065, the ambient CE evaluation has the same cokernel and determinantal failure scheme. For a geometric fibre C_b, put L_b=W_{5,b}⊗ω_{C_b}^{-1} and M_b=ω_{C_b}^{⊗2}⊗W_{5,b}^∨. As an effective divisor D ranges through Sym^6(C_b), the geometric rank-drop set is exactly |L_b|; φ_D has rank 11 precisely when O_{C_b}(D)≅L_b and rank 12 otherwise. One has deg M_b=4 and h^0(L_b)=1+h^0(M_b), hence 1≤h^0(L_b)≤4 and dim|L_b|=h^0(L_b)−1∈{0,1,2,3}; its codimension in Sym^6(C_b) is 7−h^0(L_b)∈{3,4,5,6}. The equality h^0(L_b)=4 holds exactly when C_b is hyperelliptic and M_b is the square of its hyperelliptic g^1_2. The ordered distinct-support fibre is a finite étale S_6-cover of the reduced-support open in |L_b|; it is either empty or has dimension h^0(L_b)−1.
